column1: # The validator is a structural check (balanced parens, terminated classes,
# defined escapes), so it accepts ECMA-262 patterns RE2 rejects and rejects only
# structurally malformed patterns. The official suite holds one case against
# this format, "\a" in optional/format/ecmascript-regex.json graded invalid,
# and suite_test.go skips it under reasonAnnexBIdentity as a documented
# divergence. These rows are where the boundary is written down instead.
# Row format: see loadVectorFile in vectors_test.go.
